name: Visualizer
author: BetterSoundCloud
description: Draws what SoundCloud plays, as it plays: bars, a flowing line, bars around the artwork, or MilkDrop’s classic presets, in the full-screen view, above the player, and in a view of its own. It listens only while one is on screen, and turned off, nothing of it is left running.

settings.label: In the full-screen view
settings.help: Open it from the player bar or the right-click menu.

settings.label: Above the player
settings.help: Standing on SoundCloud’s player while a track is loaded. It steps aside when you point near it, so nothing under it is out of reach.

settings.label: In its own view
settings.help: Fills SoundCloud’s page until you close it. Open it from the player bar or the right-click menu; ← and → change the look there, and ↑ and ↓ MilkDrop’s preset.

settings.label: MilkDrop changes preset
settings.help: Wherever MilkDrop shows. ↑ and ↓ change it too, in the full-screen view and in its own view.
